description: Explains a GDPR Privacy Monitor finding type, such as pre_consent_tracker or reject_flow_failed: what was detected, why it matters, and suggested wording for explaining it to the site owner, in the requested language. Looks the type up in a fixed catalogue; it does not scan anything. Technical explanation, not legal advice.

finding_type.description: Finding type as reported by get_scan_result, for example pre_consent_tracker or reject_flow_failed.

language.description: Language for explanations and the report link, as an ISO 639-1 code (one of the 24 EU languages). Defaults to en.

name: explain_finding
title: Explain a finding
